notes: Corrects the rc.2 protected-update source binding so the app, updater transaction, and deployment anchor use the same full 40-character Git commit identity.

Accepts only rc.2's exact historical 12-character lowercase hexadecimal prefix when it matches the current full commit, then canonicalizes all new transaction evidence to the full commit; every other mismatch remains fail-closed before Git.

Provides an attended recovery path for already-enrolled rc.2 machines that derives machine identity from the authorized external store and requires both the recorded rc.2 failure evidence and a clean qualified updater checkout at the exact target tag.

Allows reviewed rc.3 first-start genesis enrollment for direct upgrades from legacy checkout-local releases, bound to rc.3's exact activation and verification evidence so a missing older deployment anchor is not silently recreated.

Retains checkout-independent machine data, immutable configuration history, guarded location changes, verified pre-update backups, exact protected-byte checks, deployment anchors, and receipt-gated relaunch from rc.2.

The bundled firmware artifact is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.2 and v1.3.0-rc.1 (SHA-256 EDA070CE734D5167F0795FAF30DF461C8A07341E09CA698DE9D850315B0D5884). Direct v1.2.0-rc.6/v1.2.0 upgrades still require deployment; v1.3.0-rc.1/rc.2 machines require verified matching provenance or redeployment.

requires_firmware.note: Use the v1.3 firmware artifact bundled with this release. It is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.2 and v1.3.0-rc.1; direct v1.2.0-rc.6/v1.2.0 upgrades still require deployment, while v1.3.0-rc.1/rc.2 upgrades require verified matching provenance or redeployment.

summary: Corrected release candidate for full-commit protected updates from enrolled rc.2 machines.
validation: Target-Pi disposable SSH qualification: exact rc.2 short-binding recovery, verified backup, exact-byte preservation, full target deployment anchor, target bootstrap reopen, and contained virtual_print_array_96_v1 with private-device isolation proof
Attended LC-001 recovery update: preserved production machine data, exact target Git commit, immutable update receipts, manual target-app reopen, and remaining approved Milestone 7 HIL/Camera gates
